sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in outstanding form with five consecutive wins and a draw in their last six matches, while Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six games, making this a heavily favoured fixture for Sandbach.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match that could see them narrow the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form, host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's better-performing sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and riding a recent win, face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (sixth, recent winner) entertain Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United in a mid-table encounter. The bottom end of the table sees several struggling sides: Widnes Town visit Brereton Social, Telford Town travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads, and New Mills host Market Drayton Town in what shapes as a contest between two sides in poor form. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a fixture between lower-placed teams.
